Are twenty-five million space rocks hitting Earth's atmosphere every single day?
Shooting stars are not stars, but twenty-five million daily space rocks.

title: The 25 Million Daily Space Rocks Hitting Earth
description: Shooting stars are not distant suns at all. Millions of meteoroids vaporize in Earth's atmosphere every single day.

beats.text: Twenty-five million space rocks slam into Earth's atmosphere every single day.
beats.visual: NASA illustration of meteoroids entering Earth's upper atmosphere, 2021

beats.text: We call these bright flashes shooting stars, but they are not distant stars at all.
beats.visual: Long exposure photograph of a bright meteor streaking across the night sky, 2020
queries: Perseid meteor night sky long exposure
Bright meteor streak night sky photograph

beats.text: While drifting through deep space, a tiny rock fragment is known as a meteoroid.
beats.visual: Galileo spacecraft photograph of asteroid 243 Ida and moon Dactyl, 1993
queries: Asteroid Ida and moon Dactyl NASA

beats.text: The moment it plunges into our atmosphere and ignites, it becomes a fiery meteor.
beats.visual: Diagram illustrating comet orbit and meteoroid debris stream intersecting Earth orbit, 2018
queries: Meteor shower orbit diagram Earth comet debris
Comet dust trail Earth orbit intersection diagram

beats.text: Major showers like August's Perseids happen when Earth plows directly through dusty comet trails.
beats.visual: Night sky composite photograph of the Perseid meteor shower, 2022
queries: Perseid meteor shower composite night sky
Perseids meteor trail night sky astronomy

beats.text: Most meteoroids vaporize completely, but any surviving piece that hits the surface becomes a meteorite.
beats.visual: Polished slice of a stony-iron pallasite meteorite showing olivine crystals, 2015

beats.text: Surprisingly, some of these retrieved meteorites are actual pieces of planetary debris blasted off Mars or the Moon.
beats.visual: Photomicrograph thin section of a chondrite meteorite showing circular chondrules, 2019
queries: Martian meteorite thin section mineral photo

beats.text: That constant rain of ancient space debris is why night skies stay filled with motion.
